messages:
maria: Morning — quick release pulse. Cut window today 18:00 UTC. Canary is at 2/3 healthy right now, one node flapping. Cherry queue: 5 PRs; one flaky integration test is blocking progress. @dan any ETA on fixing #314?

dan: On it. I reproduced the flaky in tests/e2e/auth_flow.py — looks like a token expiry assertion. Working on a fix branch, should have a commit and push in ~30m.

sophia: I landed the security backport for jwt-check in a branch but it needs a devops redeploy. @tom can you take the redeploy after dan's fix lands? :crossed_fingers:

tom: Yep, I can. Plan: run `./scripts/deploy.sh canary` then tail the health checks: `kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/canary-api` and `kubectl logs -f deploy/canary-api`. I can kick off at 12:10 PST.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary redeploy by tom at 12:10 PST. Canary health checks noted a CPU spike on node g4dn-xlarge earlier, monitoring.

dan: FYI the failing trace is: ```AssertionError: token expired at tests/e2e/auth_flow.py::test_refresh_sequence``` — I'm extending expiry in the harness and will re-run CI.

maria: If canary fails we'll fallback to build 7.2.0. Please tag any PRs that touch runtime with `rollback-ready`. I've added that label to the jwt backport PR.

sophia: Noted, moving 3 low-priority infra PRs to `staging-next` so they don't block the cut. Holding other non-critical cherries until canary is stable.

tom: :thumbsup: I'll watch Grafana and SRE alerts. Ping me in-thread if you want me to abort the deploy.

dan: CI is green on the fix, pushing commit now: `git cherry-pick abc1234 && git push origin fix/e2e-auth` — will mark the PR ready.

maria: Great. Once tom confirms redeploy success we can open the release branch. Anyone planning additional cherry-picks after noon? If so please @mention here.

sophia: No additional infra cherries from my side.

dan: Only the auth fix I just pushed.

tom: Canary redeploy started. Watching logs... started at 12:11 PST, first health checks passing at 12:13 PST — currently 3/3 healthy :rocket:

release-bot: Alert: Canary CPU normalized and health checks passing. 12:16 PST.

maria: Thanks all — I'll open the cut PR if there are no regressions in the next 30m. Back to async updates, will post the cut link here when ready.
